item.lever: Experimental verification of atomistic simulation predictions
quotes: Recently, however, Rao et al . ( [35] ) have reported atomistic simulations of plastic deformation behavior for the BCC HEA in terms of dislocation motion.

which is considerably different from conventional BCC metals.
